title: Rebind Xingcheng canonical registrations to the independent top-level xingcheng root
summary: The Xingcheng package, contracts and institution data root were physically relocated from 'Standalone tools/local-model' to the independent top-level 'xingcheng' root (xingcheng/src, xingcheng/contracts, xingcheng/xingcheng). Codex live registrations still carry the retired nested paths: project_architecture_directory.physical_root for XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT, MODEL_TRAINING and MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE. This amendment rebinds those three live registration fields; superseded article text retaining the nested path is immutable history and is intentionally not rewritten.
origin: governor-directed Xingcheng migration executed in the repository (source_ownership registry already rebound to xingcheng/*); audit manifest emits activation:target:XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT dir-exists check resolving through project_architecture_directory.physical_root, which still registers the retired nested root and blocks every governed commit

evidence.physical_relocation: xingcheng/ exists with contracts, src and xingcheng subdirectories (258 renames staged from Standalone tools/local-model/{contracts,src/backend/...,xingcheng}); Standalone tools/local-model/xingcheng and Standalone tools/local-model/src/backend/csharp/GPTBridge.XingchengLearning no longer exist
evidence.permission_registry: governance_rule/permission_directory/registries/permissions/source_ownership.json already declares XINGCHENG_PACKAGE_ROOT=xingcheng/src/backend/services/xingcheng and XINGCHENG_OWNED_LANES under xingcheng/*
evidence.audit_projection: audit_checks_manifest.json regenerates activation:target:XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT (dir-exists) from project_architecture_directory.physical_root; the pre-commit audit currently fails with 'missing dir: Standalone tools/local-model/xingcheng'
evidence.derived_projection: a233_normalized_directory_entry.domain_payload mirrors physical_root and is rebuilt by the governed repair-projections step after the canonical rows change
evidence.unchanged_scope: STAR_DIRECTORY (Standalone tools/model-dialogue/xingcheng), LOCAL_MODEL, BLOCK_XINGCHENG and UNIT_ASSISTANT registrations are not touched; classification, owner, authority and runtime boundary of the three rows are unchanged
evidence.historical_text_kept: superseded articles embedding the nested path remain untouched per the AMENDMENT clause
